user.title: Set up Contraction Tracker
user.description: A local logging aid, not a medical device. Requires a working Home Assistant connection. Timings cannot determine labour stage or when birth will occur. Keep a backup timer. Phone controls are Android-first; Samsung controls lock-screen appearance. Other Home Assistant users may be able to see these records.
